name: tier-compare
description: ₹100 vs ₹1,000 vs ₹1,00,000 escalation: three paper columns standing on the bottom of the content zone, each taller than the last, revealed in sequence; the last result gets a ballpoint circle. The row spans the full content width (≈ 876 px) once every column stands. reveal: 'bars' (default — each column rises in turn, then its result) or 'results' (all columns rise together on the cut so the paper spans the full width from frame 1; only the results step in, `stagger` apart). Optional: wide (default false) stretches the row to the full ≈876 px content width whatever the tier count (2 tiers otherwise stay 276 px columns); width (px, default 0 = auto) sets the row width exactly (max 880). amtSize / resSize (px, default 0 = 44 / 64, last result 92) enlarge the amount and result text; amtSize lets the amount wrap onto two lines in its bar instead of shrinking. A row of 4+ tiers always shrinks to fit the content width.
